changes: Editable room worlds and shared visual metatile libraries preserve selected recovered room geometry at Y=0, with exact source-pixel checks.
V2 spatial bundles include World records; v1 remains readable. Transactional append remaps World and tileset/marker references; worlds, scenes and composer assets share one Undo.

Recover / import audio bridges the selected RE ROM into the existing Audio library without replacing the live emulator. Finite supported music and single-channel SFX transcriptions remain separately previewed/imported and save with the worlds in an ordinary project.
Coverage UI explains unassigned collision, unconverted entities/AI/native links, untimed poses, separate audio and existing ROM linker limits.

preservedParent.method: Exact source/test reversal reproduces the frozen parent, all protected inventories and every earlier preservation boundary. No CPU/APU/PPU, runtime compiler or world codec change.

limits: Collision stays unassigned; native links, spawn records, physics, AI and gameplay triggers are not converted into executable behavior. Only the selected room is adapted; this is not a connected full-game reconstruction.

World and scene art preserve the initial recovered layout with native Y origins recorded. Existing World/ROM/atlas capacities and the requirement to link every world-used metatile in its included tileset scene still apply. Some imported rooms need authoring before ROM export.

Audio is a separate finite transcription/import transaction and is not embedded in spatial bundles. Music replaces global order/tempo/speed and can change existing SFX timing. Single-channel SFX only; DPCM and short-mode noise are not transcribed. No full-song, native-loop, audible or hardware equivalence claim.
Known exact revisions only. Zelda poses remain untimed; Ninja scripts 15/16/89 remain partial. Native state cadence and gameplay animation/audio bindings remain unresolved.
Headless Linux Chromium direct-file checks include both games, actual World paint and audio controls, Undo/Redo and project reopen. No physical Windows/mobile/controller acceptance claim.
promotion: Standalone HTML development candidate on its own branch. No new kit, beta promotion or main-branch merge.
